objective: Close the approved product as genuinely self-administered. Code presence is not acceptance; each save must persist through the server-owned write authority and be visible again from canonical reads.
invariants: No person identity, including Samuel or Carlos, may be hardcoded as product behavior or a required user record.
Team users are created, edited, activated/deactivated, assigned roles/countries/scopes and access-provisioned from Equipo y permisos.
Browser optimistic state is never proof of persistence; self-admin Save is successful only after the protected backend commit resolves.
Multi-collection business operations use one server-owned transaction/batch or another explicit atomic contract.
Canonical readback after commit is the visual authority; localStorage, seed, legacy namespaces and conversation history are not operational authority.
Approved modules are reused; findings are mini-corrections inside A or D, not redesigns or parallel methodologies.
Cobro is never inferred from a receipt schedule or cartera balance; confirmed payment lifecycle closes separately in I6.6.
Cross-module workflows preserve actor, tenant, role, audit, notification/synchronization outcome and fail-closed behavior.

items.required: Create/edit users from Equipo, persist advisor, optionally provision/sync Auth+membership, roles, countries, scopes and credentials; no hardcoded people.
Create/edit clients from platform and confirm canonical readback plus linked activity.
Create/edit policy from platform; policy+receipts+cartera remain synchronized and atomic; no automatic cobro.
Modify insurers with persistent readback; secure credentials stay protected; login logo/favicon/build freshness corrected.
Create/update/reconcile confirmed payments from platform with auditable links to receipt/policy and no inference.
Ops/Leads transitions remain server-owned semantic workflows and synchronize Cliente360, policy/client links and activity.
Client portal and Cliente360 consume the same canonical state and never create alternate persistence.
Notifications/automation fire only after committed domain events and expose failure/retry state without duplicating records.

acceptance.release: BUILD_ONCE -> PREVIEW -> AUTHENTICATED_PROOF -> SAME_ARTIFACT_LIVE -> EXACT_READBACK -> FREEZE_OR_ROLLBACK

forbidden: silent fire-and-forget success for self-admin saves
